type: horizontal geometric section screen, NOT a slicer/toolpath/physical print
warnings: Support and bridging assessment required under track arch bays, upper galleries, entrance portico, external stair and parking canopies.
Canopy posts are 1.2 model mm diameter; roof strips and raised cap are 1.0 mm thick, intentionally thickened. Do not downscale without new section and slicer tests.
Fine attached mullion relief is not a structural wall and may disappear with coarse nozzles.
Display base is 118 by 248 mm; check build-plate clearance, adhesion and support accessibility.
Watertightness does not certify printer settings, toolpaths or a physical print. No external slicer or printer was used.
Colour 3MF uses per-triangle base materials, not filament/extruder presets.
Morphological losses include corner erosion and are not a global minimum wall-thickness proof.
